items.title: Ed Shaughnessy Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They had a classic Muppett episode he was one where he basically played the stage. [INTERVIEWEE] Right. And in the middle he stops, he says “when I play a room, I play a room.”

ctx.x: No, not really, I think he liked it, to be honest. It made so much laughs, so much fun you know.
